name: ISAKA Tsuyoshi
method: Read-only public Kaggle About page and Competitions page in the app's built-in browser, 30 October 2026, one visit each with a pause between them. Medals read from the medal icons shown beside each completed row (gold, silver and bronze icons), cross-checked against the profile medal counts; avatar image address read from the profile header's own picture element and compared by eye with the saved portrait. An older draft file, if any, was not used.

teamNotes: AI Agent Security (4th of 4,186, gold) is a team entry: Kaggle shows four accounts on it (bio4eta, yuto0712, isakatsuyoshi, rikitomo0526). The gold medal belongs to the team, not to him alone.

MAP (7th of 1,857, gold) is a team entry: Kaggle shows five accounts on it (sinchir0, takaito, isakatsuyoshi, takai380, yukitake093). The team's own writeup names the same five as team members. The medal is the team's.
LLM 20 Questions (9th of 832, gold) shows only his account, and his writeup calls it a solo gold medal, so this one can be described as his own result.
ARC Prize 2025 (92nd of 1,455, bronze) shows two accounts, isakatsuyoshi and hikari30; the bronze belongs to that entry, not to him alone.
The competition list does not display team names. The two team names given (kansai-kanto-kaggler for AI Agent Security, S T I T Y for MAP) are the bylines on the writeups pinned on his profile page.
The ARC team name 復活の混テキスト and the ARC-3 and ARC-2 team ids come from the public ARC board data already in the record, not from the Kaggle pages read here, so they were not re-confirmed.
unverified: Whether any other account on his ARC-AGI-3 or ARC-AGI-2 team shares the 復活の混テキスト team name was not confirmed on Kaggle; it rests on the earlier public board observation.
The existing record's wording that yuto0712 is a current teammate was not confirmed; Kaggle only shows yuto0712 on the finished AI Agent Security entry.
Leaderboard team names for the AI Agent Security and MAP entries were not displayed; only writeup bylines were seen.

The 64 completed entries beyond the first page of the list were not read; the solo and team activity counts in the sidebar (77 solo, 13 in a team) do not add up to the 88-entry tab count and were not reconciled.
Exact completion dates were not shown; only relative labels such as 2 months ago.
Public ARC standings were not part of this check; any ARC standing used elsewhere must be labelled provisional.
